units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 26a:1">B. Mets. 26ᵃ</cite> top <he>דשְׁתִיךְ טפי</he> (Ar. <he>דאִשְׁתִּיךְ</he>, with prefixed <cite ref="A00000"><he>א</he></cite>) when the coin found in the ground is very much attacked by rust (showing that it has been in the ground a very long time).

<cite ref="Bava Batra 19a:13">B. Bath. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>משום דמְשַׁתְּכֵי לה לקדרה</he> because they (the boulders, v. <cite ref="O01015"><he>סֶלַע</he></cite>) would eat away the pot (placed between them).
<cite ref="Shabbat 102b:2">Sabb. 102ᵇ</cite> <he>כיון דמְשַׁתְּכֵי וכ׳</he> they would not do that (keep their needles in a hole in the ground), because they would get rusty.
